Nvidia’s market value crossed $4 trillion on July 9, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. This milestone was driven primarily by strong demand for its Blackwell accelerator rack systems, specifically the GB200 and GB300 models [Source: ev-1]. The surge was further fueled by the Stargate project’s approximately $500 billion AI-infrastructure plan and repeatedly raised capital expenditure guidance from major hyperscalers including Microsoft, Meta, Google, and Amazon throughout 2025 [Source: ev-1].

At this point in time, Nvidia held a dominant share of the AI-accelerator market, with its stock price crossing roughly $160 per share [Source: ev-1]. CEO Jensen Huang highlighted the industry's transition from training to inference demand, describing "AI factories" selling compute as a commodity [Source: ev-1]. This milestone indicates that the market is pricing AI infrastructure as the largest new capital cycle since the internet era, effectively treating Nvidia as the primary "toll-booth" for this spending supercycle [Source: ev-1].
